provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

observation_model: Controlled exact label-count probabilities for the two carbon positions of neutral ethanol. Listed13C substitutions are exact isotope labels in the molecular graphs. No other isotope or natural-abundance convolution contributes. The mass instrument resolves the number of13C atoms but cannot distinguish positional isomers with the same exact mass; compare the exact molecular masses of all listed graphs to verify the observation groups.
analysis_policy: First remove the NMR datum and derive the sharp possible site1 enrichment interval from only the complete mass-count histogram and nonnegative joint fractions. Then restore the independent site1 enrichment and reconstruct all four joint state fractions. Covariance of site indicators is P(both)-P(site1)*P(site2).
scope: Analytical isotope-position identifiability, not an isotope-production procedure, metabolic pathway flux claim or instruction to create labeled biological material.
